scene.ko: 미술관 안내 데스크에서 특별전 요금, 도슨트 해설 시간, 보고 싶은 그림이 있는 곳을 묻는다.

lines.en: Hi. Is the special exhibition included in this ticket?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 표에 특별전도 포함돼 있나요?
alt: Hi. Does this ticket include the special exhibition?
Hello. Can I see the special exhibition with this ticket?

lines.en: I'm sorry, it's 8 dollars extra. It's on the third floor.
I see. Do you have any guided tours today?
alt: Okay. Are there any guided tours today?
I see. Is there a docent tour today?

lines.en: Yes, there's a free tour at 2 o'clock. It meets in the main lobby.
lines.ko: 네, 2시에 무료 해설이 있어요. 중앙 로비에서 모여요.

lines.en: Great. How long does it last?
alt: Great. How long is the tour?
Perfect. How long does it take?

lines.en: About forty-five minutes. It covers the highlights of our permanent collection.
One more thing. Where can I find Morning at Willow Lake?
lines.ko: 하나만 더요. «윌로 호수의 아침»은 어디서 볼 수 있어요?
alt: Also, where is Morning at Willow Lake?
One more question. Which room has Morning at Willow Lake?

lines.en: It's in Room 12, at the end of this hall.

expressions.en: Do you have any guided tours?

expressions.note: 작품 · 물건이 있는 곳을 물을 때
